papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.summary: Shows that learning simple dense vector embeddings for questions and passages (instead of old keyword search like TF-IDF/BM25) lets a model retrieve the right text passages much more accurately, becoming the basis for modern RAG retrieval.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
papers.summary: A comprehensive survey of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation): it organizes RAG into Naive, Advanced, and Modular paradigms and reviews retrieval, generation, and augmentation techniques plus how RAG systems are evaluated.
